clips.title: The story
paras: At Sentinel Hill, VanCleef's severed head proves the Defias leader has fallen. Carried from the depths of the Deadmines, it brings the People's Militia hard-won vengeance.

Westfall's settlers need proof that their danger has passed. For months, Edwin VanCleef directed the Defias Brotherhood's terror from the deepest sanctum of the Deadmines, guarded by armed outlaws, goblin engineers, and a massive war juggernaut. Gryan Stoutmantle, leader of the People's Militia, demands physical proof before declaring the countryside safe. VanCleef's severed head, brought out into daylight, assures the exhausted defenders that the architect of their ruin can no longer threaten Westfall.
